segments.title: 第93章 "偶遇"青梅
segments.content:
Reigniting the Verdant Years Chapter 93 "Coincidentally" Meeting a Childhood Sweetheart

An income of over ten thousand yuan a month, what does that mean?

In Li Luo's past life, back in 2018, the national personal income tax threshold was raised from 3,500 yuan to 5,000 yuan.

In other words, people with a monthly income below 5,000 yuan were not required to pay personal income tax.

Under such circumstances, the number of people paying personal income tax nationwide dropped from 187 million to 64 million.

That is to say, even as late as 2018, the number of people who could earn more than 5,000 yuan a month was just that many.

Let alone the number of people earning over ten thousand yuan a month at this point in time, in 2014!

As a developed coastal province, Qianjiang Province was doing slightly better.

But for the couple Li Guohong and his wife, who worked from dawn till dusk running a breakfast shop, Li Luo's royalty income was still a bit terrifying.

After all, for the two of them working hard for a month, the net profit of the breakfast shop was only about fifteen to twenty thousand.

After more than a decade of diligent work, they had only managed to save six to seven hundred thousand yuan.

This was already thanks to the blessings of the developed local economy.

And now their son suddenly told them that he could earn more than ten thousand a month by himself, and it would be even more in the future.

How could this not leave Lin Xiuhong and Li Guohong utterly shocked?

You have to understand, the breakfast shop's income was what the two of them earned together.

If it were to be split in half and counted per person, their individual monthly incomes weren't even as high as Li Luo's royalties!

That was twelve thousand!

At this thought, both Lin Xiuhong and Li Guohong were at a loss for words. After exchanging a glance, they didn't know what to say for a moment.

After finally snapping out of it and gradually calming the shock in her heart, Lin Xiuhong took a deep breath and slowly asked, "Here is the five thousand you mentioned, so where's the remaining ten thousand plus? In your bank card?"

"The royalties for each month are announced on the 3rd, and then they're transferred to the linked bank card on the 12th." Li Luo answered honestly, "Including this five thousand, there's just under six thousand in the card now."

"Didn't you say it was over seven thousand?" Lin Xiuhong raised an eyebrow. "Did you buy something?"

"No, I have to pay taxes, you know," Li Luo explained. "11% of tax is withheld in advance."

"Oh, right, right." Lin Xiuhong's mind was still a bit slow. After it clicked, she nodded repeatedly. "So how are these royalties of yours announced? Can we see it?"

"Sure." Li Luo took out his phone, used the browser to log in to the website, and opened the author's back-end. "Look, here are the royalty earnings for August, and then for September."

Li Guohong leaned over from the side, and he and Lin Xiuhong carefully examined it together. On it, a figure of over seven thousand and another of twelve thousand were clearly recorded.

Then the two of them looked at the five thousand yuan of solid cash in their hands. They looked at each other, not quite knowing what to say.

"Actually," Li Luo coughed twice, turning to comfort his parents, "I think what Great Uncle said makes sense too."

"After all, I worked so hard to get into Fuyizhong, so I should still prioritize my studies."

"No matter what I do, it can't affect my studies. I understand this point as well."

Speaking to this point, Li Luo paused, then looked at his parents with a sincere expression and said, "But, what if I can guarantee that my grades won't drop, that getting into Qianjiang University is a sure thing, and I still have the energy to write?"

"Then there would be no problem at all."

Hearing Li Luo say this, Lin Xiuhong and Li Guohong also felt it made sense.

But Li Guohong quickly frowned. "I saw just now, you write 2,000 words a chapter. I usually see you writing two chapters a day, that's 4,000 words."

"Your language exam essays are only seven or eight hundred words. You're writing 4,000 words every day, can your brain handle that?"

"A month or two is one thing, but can you really keep this up for a year or two? A royalty of twelve thousand is a lot, but your health is more important."

"I understand that." Li Luo nodded and said, "But you might have misunderstood one thing. Writing web novels is my hobby. It's a very happy thing to do when I'm writing, just like playing a game. It's a form of relaxation, completely different from studying."

To fool his parents, Li Luo had no choice but to say some things against his conscience.

However, for him, with the memory palace to rely on, both studying and typing were easy tasks, so there was no need to worry about the physical burden.

So the key was still how to convince his parents.

"Really?" Lin Xiuhong was naturally half-convinced and half-skeptical upon hearing his explanation. "If it's as easy as you say, isn't earning money from web novels like picking it up for free?"

"How can that be the same," Li Luo shook his head repeatedly. "Liking to write is one thing, but whether you write well or not is another thing entirely."

"It's just like playing basketball."

"I really like playing basketball, and I'm relaxed and happy when I play, but I can't make money by playing."

"Kobe and Jordan are also very relaxed and happy when they play basketball, but don't they just make tons of money?"

When it came to reasoning, Lin Xiuhong and Li Guohong's two mouths combined couldn't out-argue Li Luo.

But Li Luo knew that just reasoning with them definitely wouldn't be enough to put his parents at ease.

So after speaking, he immediately added, "Actually, this is very simple."

"The mid-term exams are coming up soon after the National Day holiday."

"When the exam results come out, you'll know whether or not it's affecting my grades."

"If my grades ever drop in the future, you can make me stop writing web novels at any time."

Once these words were out, Lin Xiuhong and Li Guohong instantly quieted down, feeling that what he said made a lot of sense.

Of course, the key here was still that Li Luo's royalty earnings were simply too much.

Twelve thousand a month...

Originally, after they bought the apartment, the six thousand yuan monthly mortgage payment had put a slight bit of pressure on the couple.

But now that their son suddenly had such a high income, this pressure instantly vanished without a trace.

"You can just keep this five thousand," Li Luo said. "I don't spend much on food and drink anyway. I'll just use the royalties to pay the family's mortgage."

"How can we do that." Li Guohong frowned. "There's no sense in a father having his son pay the mortgage, especially when you haven't even work..."

Halfway through his sentence, Li Guohong shut his mouth again.

It was true that Li Luo didn't have a proper job yet, but he was earning more than someone with a proper job.

On this point, Lin Xiuhong, being a woman, was a bit more open-minded and not as concerned about face as Li Guohong. A gratified smile appeared on her face. "It's true that there's not much use for you to have this money."

"Since you have this intention, we'll use the royalties to pay the mortgage. As for the rest, you keep it properly. Use it to marry a wife in the future."

"Uh..." Li Luo was taken aback for a moment, then laughed in spite of himself, "Getting married is so far in the future, it's still very early."

"Just don't start spending lavishly now that you have money," Lin Xiuhong glanced at him. "I'll have Xixi keep an eye on you, to make sure you don't spend recklessly."

Hearing this, Li Luo's expression changed slightly, and he quickly reminded her, "Mom, it's fine for her to supervise me, but don't mention the fact that I'm writing a book."

"What's there to not talk about?" Lin Xiuhong looked at him suspiciously.

"Ahem." Li Guohong, on the side, chimed in at the right time to help Li Luo out. "We didn't know before, so we talked about it. But now that Li Luo is earning so much money a month, you shouldn't just go telling everyone everything. Don't you understand the principle of getting rich quietly?"

"Alright then." Lin Xiuhong nodded and agreed.

Li Luo shot his dad a grateful look. Li Guohong smiled and gave him a look that all men would understand.

After all, he was someone who had read the actual content of Li Luo's novel, so he knew very well what was written inside. If that little girl Ying Chanxi were to read it, it would indeed be a bit embarrassing.

On this, the father still expressed his support for Li Luo.

"Then it's settled," Lin Xiuhong said. "Do your best on the mid-term exams. Don't disappoint us."

"Okay, absolutely no problem."

Li Luo agreed readily.

With this matter settled, Li Luo breathed a sigh of relief.

Lin Xiuhong curiously asked for a few more details about web novels, and then went to the balcony to hang the clothes.

Li Luo originally wanted to go back to his bedroom, planning to stay the night at home.

But on second thought, Ying Chanxi was all alone over at Bihai Lanting. If he didn't go back, she would probably nag him for a whole day tomorrow.

So Li Luo got up from the sofa, patted his butt, and said to his dad, "Then I'll head back first."

"Hmm? You're not staying home tonight?" Li Guohong asked strangely.

"I made plans with Ying Chanxi," Li Luo fibbed. "We study together every night, so she can teach me how to learn."

"You finally know to ask Xixi for help." Li Guohong chuckled twice, then waved his hand and said, "Then go on, don't keep her waiting."

"Alright, bye-bye."

Li Luo said goodbye to his parents, changed into his shoes at the door, and pushed it open.

But just as he closed the door behind him and was about to go downstairs, he heard the sound of footsteps from below.

Ying Chanxi's figure appeared around the corner of the staircase, and they saw each other face-to-face.

"Why did you come back here?" Li Luo looked surprised.

Ying Chanxi, having been discovered, had a slight blush on her little face. She immediately retorted, "Why are you coming out? Aren't you sleeping at home tonight?"

"I'm going back there to sleep. Are you coming home to sleep?"

Hearing Li Luo's words, Ying Chanxi quickly said, "No, no, I just had dinner with Xinyan and went for a walk. We happened to be near here, so I came back to get some things."

As she spoke, Ying Chanxi pretended to take out her keys and open her door, then turned her head and said, "Wait for me a moment, I'll go back with you after I get my things."

"Then you might as well just sleep at home. You can go back tomorrow." Seeing that Ying Chanxi was already back, Li Luo suggested.

"How can I do that? Let's go back there." Ying Chanxi shook her head repeatedly.

The panda doll and Li Luo's small blanket were still over at Bihai Lanting. If she stayed here tonight, how would she be able to sleep?

(End of Chapter)
